notes.title: What can you expect from The Soul?
notes.content:
[p]Today, we will lift the veil of secrecy and reveal what awaits you in the mysterious and mystical world of The Soul. In our project, which we are doing in collaboration with [b][url="https://t.me/red_star_games"]Red Star Games[/url][/b].[/p][p]The Soul is a story-driven third-person action/horror game that explores the concept of the human soul.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]A little about the plot (no spoilers)[/b][/h3][p]The game world is an alternative version of our modern world, where monsters live and hide among humans.[/p][p]You will play as a Guardian named Max Soul, who has been saving people and exterminating monsters for many years.[/p][p]It is no coincidence that we mentioned that our project focuses on the storyline. We put our heart and soul into the script for The Soul. We want you to love the characters as much as we did while creating the game.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcEXBRWdhMvgc1_OCQTxT9cOfR6VbsAyVT8qbLI_4Wt03XRa2sjDws69ErP7OETXY73KATWCM6hgnggBB0l6r7SNuQdBTHNLiDBx_agqZzB1O8VaXC5PKTC2pdVGXYZ7jeUNhIC?key=IrlrVNKU6t8AAaw51B_lMA"][/img][/p][h3][b]Cinematography and Cut Scenes[/b][/h3][p]They are a key feature of the project. We want you to immerse yourself in the story as much as possible and, while playing, find yourself thinking that you are watching a thrilling thriller. We spend a lot of time working on animations, as storytelling is a very important part of our project. Cinematic cutscenes are the first thing you will encounter in The Soul.[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdPC9GvA_82TbRFqH4yCyJCtfT82VjIeItzPovJgeE3Im2DBUI7qR9qxWdRJsjq7SnqvizSBWj-v5tOBJuK81qJg_mp1YcmSFZO_F4WSd_2OrF9aW97pTApdEi2nUU2D5zfjMjBpA?key=IrlrVNKU6t8AAaw51B_lMA"][/img][/p][h3][b]Voice control[/b][/h3][p]This mechanic will allow you to participate in the story not only indirectly, by controlling the main character, but also personally, by speaking lines that Max Soul will have to repeat to his interlocutor into the microphone. The dialogues will not only reveal the plot, but also be part of the investigation.[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXf_NLkaeH1xYJXFsG3yr4EjrwVep3kNyh-f49Ji-Gkdww_nhf37V30DO37CHCNAOdznZsl-KlTuxsNEO5p_Blb--S8I7xezxTHNxCsQaM7FfK6OkXHQoRy3n5QRNztopiC8sjfH?key=IrlrVNKU6t8AAaw51B_lMA"][/img][/p][h3][b]Investigation and research[/b][/h3][p]Each chapter of The Soul is a short detective story. You need to find clues that will help you identify the monster so that you can then eliminate it. Once you have found all the clues, you can piece them together using Max Soul's diary.[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXe1a65YJ8j8rvAdm7_su-0AfSM32O_ddT6IYuwOzNnjQQuZ6jxRh18kG5AgCnYqPV-UrtoEtxt1oyaj__s8zxEIuxBNjGatv_CynwvkL_M_jOjXRM7FqAmXQL2VKdmsRpDFBLCl?key=IrlrVNKU6t8AAaw51B_lMA"][/img][/p][h3][b]Max's diary and monster identification[/b][/h3][p]These are two interconnected mechanics. Max's diary will contain all the information you need to compare clues. Your task is to draw the right conclusion and determine which monster you are hunting. If you do everything correctly, you will understand which weapon to take with you to win the battle.[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXepAL57Z9aJ2dDoWHUzLB4bSovrrVOi8gctjCBLaW9hcrdWhmF2g1oOrgBZwQOQJIxMAhzm-MNbb5Golo37E_XsvWpPllxZauLR5_cAzsEUCaqbEjRJewbeYw7Uj_wjkszs72ftjQ?key=IrlrVNKU6t8AAaw51B_lMA"][/img][/p][h3][b]Choices that influence events[/b][/h3][p]When talking to or interrogating NPCs, you can choose the direction the dialogue will take: whether Max will be reserved or explosive, support the other person, or take the opposite side.[/p][p]Disclaimer! Since we are a small team, don't expect serious plot twists in the spirit of David Cage's projects (Heavy Rain, Detroit: Become Human). However, you will notice certain differences (as, for example, in TellTale projects, where choices in dialogues do not radically change the overall plot). We hope you'll like them.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfdckxGYRoSeLJx--_JWHnzZWnQASE1jtKWreg57EP-bvJRGmOEoHlERdYvPrF761l1Sc7xgaahVcU6Sy1__HtZJ2sdjRa3k98v4G6NJHbleFRCeM5iJR06rdWFh9DtL4UDsChe?key=IrlrVNKU6t8AAaw51B_lMA"][/img][/p][h3][b]Combat system[/b][/h3][p]What awaits you: third-person shooting and dodging. The Soul is not only a movie with dialogue, but also a third-person action game. Be warned—choosing the wrong weapon will spell trouble for you and Max...[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdtR-faJpgCwdkLe7KKgpBVXjXAjnJ8TvX88RziD5Dc9I0IF0ohMX5IQOgep90sXTe0a7b_HQdz2oeLD06niFeoap_NmfP1Bk3D-TO2XuyZwct7MnMNi2CNOLPzdYHTeCBW5YZi6Q?key=IrlrVNKU6t8AAaw51B_lMA"][/img][/p][h3][b]QTE[/b][/h3][p]Be attentive, press the right buttons at the right time, and you will be rewarded with the desired cutscene.[/p][p]Add the game to your wishlist! Be sure to follow our social media accounts at [b][url="https://taplink.cc/antelus_games"]Antelus Games[/url][/b] so you can stay up to date on all the latest news about The Soul, other projects from our studio, and influence their future.[/p][p][b]Today, we are pleased to announce that the demo version of The Soul is in the final stages of development and will be released to the public soon![/b][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: The Soul: about the project, genre, setting
notes.content:
[h2]About the project[/h2]
We are creating the project together with RedStarGames studio. Our acquaintance happened in 2023 at the IGROPROM exhibition. Two brothers were creating a project on Unreal Engine 5, which according to all copyright laws was impossible to monetize without a license. That is, they worked for the sake of their business, gaining experience and for fun.

This is how the collaboration of Antelus Games and RedStarGames took place. And what will come out of it, you will find out soon, together with the release of The Soul project in 2025.


[h2]Genre[/h2]
Action-adventure from the 3rd person.

[h2]Setting[/h2]
Alternate modernity with a touch of mysticism, where monsters lurk among humans.

[i]"It all started with one session with patient #17.
He asked me to look into the reasons for his erratic decision making and wanted to consult a psychologist. My usual conversations with him intrigued me. He talked about arguing with himself. About how every time a choice presents itself in life, his inner self contradicts his desires.
Finding no answers, I decided to calm him down and put him into a hypnotic sleep. It was then that the veil of another world began to open to me."

Excerpt from Marcos Miller's notes
[/i]
